known_deltas: Threshold audit (0.3): v3.0 literals in config.legacy_verification with IDENTICAL defaults; no conflicts vs agent thresholds.
Wikidata quirks (live-verified): API errors = HTTP 200 + {"error":{...}}; search hit has no aliases; redirects parser supports list and dict forms.
Pleiades (1.2): unreachable from dev network; defensive parser + network-marker live test; hostname-only (no hardcoded IPs).
Trismegistos (1.2): no public API (SSL chain + 403) -> stub adapter (no_public_api); datasets deferred.
Fragment orthogonality (a086a4b): is_fragment = source lacuna; completeness_score = extraction quality; needs_attention aggregate. Entities carry both fields.
Verification 2.0 (1.3, c201bb4): package aeon/verification/; legacy verification.py removed; root aeon/verdicts.py = shim.
Logician fix (3daaf97): <2 claims -> abstained (false positive forbidden); translated-source contract test added.
verify_atom projection: legacy keys + v4.0 keys; abstained -> 'unverified'; signature extended kw-only (trace_id, mode).
1.4 integration: translator verify_mode off/basic/full (verify=True legacy -> full); trace_id = atom.meaning_hash; engine mode param skips Expert in basic.

Demo CLI (1.4): python -m aeon.demo --text examples/plato_sample.txt --verify=full; MockLLM moved to aeon/testing.py with latency_ms; demo metrics on mock 200ms: 4 LLM calls, avg_time_per_atom_network=0.803s (extrapolation) << 30s target.
Metrics targets evidence (1.4): test_metrics_targets_on_warm_cache asserts cache_hit_rate>=0.7 and network_calls_per_atom<=5 on warm-cache reruns.

Coverage (1.4): pytest-cov --cov segfaults on Windows (0xC0000005, CTracer+torch DLL conflict; google_ai-consulted known issue; COVERAGE_CORE/.coveragerc timid/CLI timid all failed).
